hero.prompt: An ancient stone throne sits empty on a vast open plain beneath a deep star-filled sky, translucent golden ancestor-spirit forms rising like luminous mist from the earth around it as if offering the throne from below, a pale ketu crescent arc glowing teal overhead and starlight cascading softly onto the throne from above, the seat radiating inherited amber and gold from within as if centuries of lineage illuminate it, Leo stars faint and proud in the immense indigo canopy above, deep indigo-to-near-black palette (#16112c fading to #0b0a1b), soft gold accents (#d4af6a), teal-and-gold nebula wash, painterly editorial illustration, full-bleed wide 16:9 composition that fills the entire frame, ONE single continuous landscape scene, no split screen, no diptych, no two panels, no diagram, no chart wheel, no central framed card, no text or letters or numerals, no human faces
hero.altEn: An ancient throne glowing with inherited gold in a vast night landscape, ancestor spirits rising as mist around it
hero.altZh: 一把古老宝座在广袤星空下散发着黄金般的祖传光芒，先祖灵魂如薄雾从大地升腾

inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read Magha in a Chart
inline.titleEn: 5 Steps to Reading a Magha Placement
inline.titleZh: 解读摩伽星宿盘面的五个步骤
inline.altEn: Five-step sequence for reading Magha nakshatra in a birth chart
inline.altZh: 解读出生盘中摩伽星宿的五步流程图

items.subEn: Magha spans 0° to 13°20' of Leo — the first slice of the sign
items.subZh: 摩伽占据狮子座0°至13°20'，即该星座的起始段

items.subEn: Read the placement through lineage and the past, not raw ambition
items.subZh: 通过血脉与过去来解读此位置，而非原始野心

items.subEn: Ask what family legacy, name, or inheritance the chart is asking to honor
items.subZh: 探询星盘要求当事人承载的家族遗产、姓名或传承

items.subEn: Duty alongside a pull toward letting go — a feature, not a flaw
items.subZh: 承担义务与渴望放手并存——这是特质，而非缺陷

items.subEn: Natural leader is half the picture; the fuller read is authority received, then reckoned with
items.subZh: 天生领袖只是一半答案；更完整的解读是权威被接受，然后被正视

inline.titleZh: 关于摩伽星宿的四种常见误读
inline.altEn: Four common misreadings of Magha nakshatra corrected with the inherited-authority framework
inline.altZh: 以继承权威框架纠正四种摩伽星宿常见误读的图解

items.subEn: The throne is inherited, not guaranteed power — it describes lineage, not outcomes
items.subZh: 宝座是继承而来，而非保证权力——描述的是血脉，而非结果

items.subEn: Ketu rules Magha; authority looks backward into ancestry, not upward into status
items.subZh: 计都主宰摩伽；权威朝向祖先的过去，而非阶层地位

items.subEn: Ketu's detachment runs underneath — standing often comes with ambivalence about legacy
items.subZh: 计都的超然潜行其中——地位往往伴随着对遗产的矛盾感

items.subEn: The frame is identical for anyone — check inherited dignity first, regardless of status
items.subZh: 框架对所有人相同——无论地位如何，先检视继承的尊严
